name: Form
summary: A native form that checks on submit, lists the errors in a summary with links to the fields, moves focus to the first invalid field, announces the result once and maps server errors to fields by name.
useWhen: Any set of fields sent together with one submit button
A form that needs custom checks next to the browser's own (type, pattern, required)
A form whose server answer can say which field is wrong
A short form inside a Dialog, with the submit Button in the footer
avoidWhen: A long form the person fills over several steps
One setting that saves the moment it changes
A search box or a filter row that updates a list as the person types

size.description: Space between the fields and the parts. Shared with the fields through useFormContext().

orientation.description: The default orientation of every FormField: label above, or label at the start of the line.

validators.description: Custom checks by field name, run after the browser constraint check. Each returns a message or nothing.

onSubmit.description: Called with the values when every check passes. May return server errors in any shape mapServerErrors reads; a promise keeps the form in submitting.

onErrors.description: Called with the field errors each time a submit finds some.

serverErrors.description: Errors from outside, such as a server action rendered with the page. Shown without moving focus.

actions.description: The buttons, in the actions part. FormSubmit first.

labels.description: Copy for the summary title and the built in errors. Default from the Theme language, English or Arabic.

a11y.role: form, the native element. Give it aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one form.
a11y.focus: On a submit with errors, focus moves to the first invalid field in form order; when no field can take it, to the summary. Values are kept.

keys.Tab: Moves through the fields, then the actions. The form adds no stop of its own.
keys.Enter: In a single line field, submits the form through its submit button. On a summary link, moves focus to that field.

a11y.announce: Once per submit with errors, a polite status says how many fields to fix (WCAG 4.1.3). The summary itself is not a live region, so nothing is read twice. Each field reads its error through aria-describedby when focus lands on it.
notes: Hand built on the native form with noValidate: the browser bubble never shows, and type, pattern, min and maxLength still feed the check through checkValidity().
An empty control with native required or aria-required (Field sets aria-required) gets the required message.
After a submit, a change that fixes a field removes its error at once. A change never adds an error: checks run on submit.
autocomplete is never changed and values are never cleared on an error, so nothing is asked twice (WCAG 3.3.7, 3.3.8).
aria-busy is true while onSubmit runs, and FormSubmit shows its loading state.

A form in a Dialog: the form sits in DialogBody with an id, and the submit Button in DialogFooter takes form set to that id and type submit. Enter in a field still submits. That footer Button is outside the Form context, so it shows no loading state: give it loading from your own state when onSubmit is slow.
The action prop is not taken: the form checks before it sends, and React does not run an action on a submit that is stopped. Call the server action from onSubmit and return its errors.
When onSubmit throws, the summary says the form could not be sent and focus moves to it. Values are kept.
Read only controls, hidden inputs and controls in a disabled Fieldset are not checked.

en.submit: A verb plus a noun that names the result: Send request, Save address, Create account. Never Submit, OK or Continue.
en.summary: Fix 2 fields to send the form. Count the fields, name the goal.
en.errors: Each says what to do with the field: Add your city. Use your work email, not a personal one.
en.required: Say once, above the form, that fields marked * are required.

ar.submit: اسم الفعل مع الشيء: إرسال الطلب، حفظ العنوان، إنشاء الحساب
ar.errors: كل خطأ يقول وش يسوي: اكتب المدينة. استخدم بريد العمل مو البريد الشخصي
ar.required: سطر واحد فوق النموذج: الحقول اللي عليها * مطلوبة

react.behavior: hand built native form, shared logic in packages/shared/src/form.ts, Alert as the summary

angular.behavior: form[dsForm] host bindings and native submit, input, change and reset listeners; div[dsFormField]; button[dsFormSubmit]; checks through packages/shared/src/form.ts; reads @angular/forms errors through the ControlContainer on the same form (reactive FormGroup or template NgForm)
angular.note: onSubmit is a function input (it returns server errors or a promise); onErrors is the errors output; actions takes a TemplateRef rendered with the form injector. Form.css is used as is.

styles.studio: Fields stacked with a roomy gap, the danger Alert summary on top, the actions on one wrapping line at the start
styles.desk: The same layout, in Instrument Sans, the summary Alert in its Desk look
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A submit button that stays disabled until every field is valid
mistakes.right: An enabled submit that checks, lists the errors and moves focus to the first one

mistakes.wrong: Checking every field on each key press and showing errors while the person types
mistakes.right: Check on submit; after that, remove an error as soon as the field is fixed

mistakes.wrong: A summary with role alert and a field error that is also live, so each error is read twice
mistakes.right: One polite status per submit, and errors read through aria-describedby

mistakes.wrong: Clearing the fields or the password after a server error
mistakes.right: Keep every value and show the server message on the field it names

mistakes.wrong: A multi step flow built as one long Form with hidden sections
